The total length of $AC = AF + FG + GC = 13 + 52 + 26 = 91$.

$AD = \frac{4}{28} AB = \frac{1}{7} AB$ and $AF = \frac{13}{91} AC = \frac{1}{7} AC$.
By the converse of Thales's theorem (or similar triangles), $DF \parallel BC$.
Similarly, $AE = AD+DE = 4+16 = 20$. $AG = AF+FG = 13+52 = 65$.
